stemMd: Which displayed equation has roots 2 and −3 and a left-hand polynomial with leading coefficient 2?
explanationMd: The factored expression is 2(x − 2)(x + 3). Expanding gives 2(x² + x − 6) = 2x² + 2x − 12. Both the roots and leading coefficient must match.

distractorRationale.e: This has the roots but leading coefficient one instead of two.
distractorRationale.b: This gives roots three and negative two.
distractorRationale.a: Multiplying only the leading term does not preserve the intended factors.
distractorRationale.d: This corresponds to roots negative two and negative three.
